summary: Appeal against High Court's rejection of Section 482 Cr.P.C. application; Magistrate directed FIR registration under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C. after police refusal; offence under IPC s.294 held cognizable; act not in official duty, sanction under s.197 Cr.P.C. not required; High Court upheld order; standard of prima facie case met; magistrate's discretion in ordering investigation affirmed.
final_judgment: Appeal disposed of; impugned order upheld; FIR registration directed.
